title: A / Concept Lab
selection: Complete A section of the supplied dictionary, including affixes, abbreviations, accented entries, and separate source homographs. Exact duplicates and Usage paragraphs are not counted as entries.
notes: The first 100 headwords retain their curated meanings and links. Additional entries preserve dictionary text, with rule-based categories, extracted cues, and source-derived links. Imported entries can contain several unsplit numbered senses. Weights are experimental, not learned probabilities; addresses are identifiers, not semantic distances.

comparisons.text: Abate means making something less strong; abolish means putting an end to it. A reduction is different from an ending.
Ability names the capacity itself. Able describes someone or something that has that capacity.
Abandon has the broader sense of giving up or leaving. Abdicate specifically concerns giving up a throne, duty, or right.
Both are community leaders: an abbot heads a community of monks, while an abbess heads a community of nuns.
Abhor is the action of detesting; abhorrence names the feeling of disgust or detestation.
These are two meanings of the same spelling: a calculating frame and an architectural slab. They are stored at separate addresses.
Abridge shortens a whole work, such as a book or film. Abbreviate commonly shortens a word or expression.
Abrogate specifically concerns repealing a law or similar rule. Abolish is broader, including ending a custom or institution.
Absent describes someone or something as not present. Absence names the state or period of being away.
Absorb is the action of taking something in. Absorbent describes a material or substance capable of doing that.
Abstain means refraining from an activity. Abstemious describes moderation or restraint, especially in eating and drinking.
The theoretical meaning describes an idea rather than a concrete thing. The summary meaning names a condensed account of a document.
Absolute temperature is a measurement counted from a reference point. Absolute zero is that lowest theoretical reference point.
